units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 6b:10">Kidd. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳ לא קנה</he> if the transaction is a sale (of land), he has not acquired possession (by delivering the purchasing money as a loan).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 47a">Ib. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>ושוין במ׳</he> and they agree in the case of a sale.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 11:4">Keth. XI, 4</cite> <he>מִכְרָהּ בטל</he> her sale is invalid; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="M01667"><he>מִמְכָּר</he></cite>.
